claim: The pipeline consists of 7 sequential stages: detect(), extract(), build_graph(), cluster(), analyze(), report(), and export().
Each stage communicates through plain Python dicts and NetworkX graphs with no shared state and no side effects outside the graphify-out/ directory.
The extract() function returns a dictionary with 'nodes' and 'edges' keys, where each node has 'id', 'label', and 'source_file' fields and each edge has 'source', 'target', and 'type' fields.
Module-top-level indirect_call sources and bash source/script-invocation targets that minted a node id from an absolute path are canonicalized to the root-relative node id in graph.json.
The post-commit hook refuses to overwrite an existing graph.json if it is over the size cap or unparseable, matching the CLI behavior.
Closure parameters in JS/TS (e.g., `rows.map(r => ...)`) now shadow outer names, preventing false indirect_call edges from binding to a corpus-wide callable of the same name.
graphify achieves LOCOMO retrieval recall@10 of 0.497, approximately 10x mem0 (0.048) and above BM25 (0.362).
graphify's LOCOMO QA accuracy is 45.3%, which is within 4.4 percentage points of supermemory (49.7%) at about a tenth of supermemory's ingest cost ($1.40 vs $15.67).
graphify builds its graph index with zero LLM credits ($0), while the LOCOMO ingest cost is approximately $1.40.
The project is named Graphify and is hosted at graphify.com
The project is maintained by the Graphify-Labs organization
The project logo is hosted at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Graphify-Labs/graphify/v8/docs/logo.png
The project has a graphify knowledge graph stored at graphify-out/ directory
The command `graphify update .` updates the graph using AST-only analysis with no API cost
The file graphify-out/wiki/index.md can be navigated instead of reading raw files if it exists
graphify runs as a Claude Code skill and optionally as a local MCP stdio server.
safe_fetch() streams responses and aborts at 50 MB, and safe_fetch_text() aborts at 10 MB.
security.validate_url() allows only http and https schemes, blocks private/loopback/link-local IPs, and blocks cloud metadata endpoints.
Tree-sitter parses code files and extracts classes, functions, imports, call graphs, and inline comments in Pass 1.
Pass 1 supports 25 programming languages for code structure extraction.
Community detection uses the Leiden algorithm to group nodes by edge density without requiring embeddings.
The Docker MCP Toolkit catalog entry `sqlite-mcp-server` (image `mcp/sqlite-mcp-server`) is broken because its entrypoint `/app/.venv/bin/mcp-server-sqlite` does not exist in the published layer.
The `SQLite` catalog entry (`mcp/sqlite`) is marked 'Archived' in catalog metadata but boots and serves correctly.
The SQLite MCP server provides six tools: `read_query`, `write_query`, `create_table`, `list_tables`, `describe_table`, and `append_insight`.
graphify exposes graph structure, source files, node labels, and relationships via graph.json
graphify's behavior is offline and deterministic by default
graphify explain is a command that displays node information
